name: Mapterhorn attribution (per-source terms)
content:
Terrain © Mapterhorn.

Mapterhorn assembles its elevation tiles from public-domain, CC0, CC BY and national open-government datasets, each carrying its own attribution requirement. The current list of sources, and the credit each one requires, is published at:
https://mapterhorn.com/attribution

The app links to that page rather than copying it: some source approvals (for example the survey-results approval issued for Japanese elevation data) carry approval numbers that rotate, and the live page is the authoritative text.
